themeMechanism.how: persisted in the HOST user-settings document (namespace ui-theme, field preference), projected to two DOM fields: document.documentElement.style.colorScheme and document.body[data-ds-dark-theme] (present == dark). On a fresh page load both are set by a server-rendered inline boot script whose value is read from settings.yaml per index request, before any client plugin runs. Palette values come from injected CSS body{...}/body[data-ds-dark-theme]{...}; built-in themes register empty token sets, so inline body tokens exist only from override layers (wallpaper).
